title: every refusal names the field and what was allowed
question: can a caller fix the request from the response alone?
rule: A 400 carries `fields`, each with the field name and the error.
An unknown state is refused with the allowed set and the value that was sent.
A wrong method on a known path is 405 with the allowed methods, not 404.

steps.name: a missing title says which field
an unknown state says what was allowed
an undeclared route is a 404 that names the path
a wrong method is a 405 that names the right one
